raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Strength for Meniscus Rehab"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase lower-body and overall strength with knee-safe progressions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Load Management" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Controlled Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x60s rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower - Hip Dominant & Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Controlled Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          quad_stretch 2x60s rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x50s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower - Hip Dominant & Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower - Stability & Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          side_plank 3x40s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Deload Focused":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower - Deload & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength Emphasis" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower - Heavy Hips & Safe Quads":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 5x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 5x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower - Posterior Chain & Control":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 5x5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x45s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower - Heavy Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 5x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          front_squat 4x4..5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Volume Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          arnold_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x70s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower - Posterior & Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 5x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Heavy Intensity":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x3 rpe 9..9.5 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 4x3..4 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          split_squat 3x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Peak Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x75s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower - Control & Power (Low Impact)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x4 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Deload & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower - Deload & Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Return-to-Skiing Strength & Conditioning" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower - Strength & Single-leg Control":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          front_squat 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          step_up 5x5 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x45s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Strength Maintenance":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x80s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower - Ski-specific Strength (Knee-safe)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x4 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower - Max Strength & Control":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 5x3 rpe 9..9.5 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 4x3..4 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          step_up 5x4 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Power & Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 5x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x90s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower - RFD & Control (Low Impact)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x3..4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Taper & Maintenance":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          front_squat 3x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          step_up 3x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x45s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Taper":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          cable_row 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower - Pre-ski Prep (Low Impact Agility)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Deload & Readiness":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower - Return Check & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m

goals.name: Increase lower-body and overall strength with knee-safe progressions
